name: word-roller-gradient-wave
title: Word Roller Gradient Wave
description: Words swap one after another with their letters rising in, each letter shifting hue in a slow blue wave across the word, over a progress bar; the last word settles in the accent blue, a little bigger.
useWhen: A sequence of verbs or values (dream, design, develop, deliver) that ends on a payoff word.
A light title card where the colour carries a quiet sense of motion.
avoidWhen: A flat single-colour look: the letters always shift hue.
Many words with different lengths: the row recentres at every word.
author: lifeprompt-team

variables.label: Words
variables.description: Words in order, separated by commas. The last one is where it settles.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Size of the word in pixels. A wide word shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.label: Hue
variables.description: Centre hue of the letter colours in degrees (215 is blue).

variables.label: Final hue
variables.description: Hue of the last word (221 is the accent blue).

variables.label: Background
variables.description: Fill behind the text. Use transparent to lay the block over your own footage.

variables.label: Frames per word
variables.description: How long each word is shown, in 30 fps frames.
